Dialogs.Dialog: So I hear you've been getting close with someone on the tennis team lately.
So I hear you've been getting close with someone at your part-time job lately.
Huh, so there really is someone. You're doing surprisingly well for yourself.
Now, now. Good for you, though. Ah, young love. Woo-hoo!
(...Man, now I feel kind of sheepish.)
So how have things been going with that girl on the tennis team？
So how have things been going with that girl from work？
Progress？ It's not really like that...
Oh, come on, don't give me that. You like her, don't you？
(All right, that wraps up library duty for today... Huh？ Where did ▲小早川＊▲ go？)
Waiting on the roof. Come up. Rinko
What's wrong？ Calling me out to a place like this... *pant*
Look at you, in such a rush. Did you think I was up here crying again？
I just... wanted to say thank you. Properly.
Whenever I was in trouble, you helped me out.
When those guys hassled me at the arcade, and with my family... Whenever I was all alone, you helped me.
You're really like a big brother to me.
Yeah, and you're like a little sister to me, ▲小早川＊▲.
From now on... will you keep being Rinko's... I mean, my big brother？
Yeah. Can't take my eyes off you just yet, after all.
Hehe. Don't let it go to your head.
Thank you, really. Stick by me from now on, okay？
(All right, that wraps up library duty for today... Huh？ Where did ▲小早川＊▲ go？)
(Reminds me of when ▲小早川＊▲ confessed to me...)
(Well, that's it for library duty today... Huh？ Where'd ▲小早川＊▲ go？)
What are you doing？ I'm on the roof. Rinko
(What am I doing？ What about you... The roof... Don't tell me, not again...)
(Reminds me of when ▲小早川＊▲ confessed to me...)
(Well, that's it for library duty today... Huh？ Where'd ▲小早川＊▲ go？)
(The sunset？ Is she on the roof...？ Don't tell me...)
(Reminds me of when ▲小早川＊▲ confessed to me...)
(Well, that's it for library duty today... Huh？ Where'd ▲小早川＊▲ go？)
(The roof... Don't tell me, not again...)
Good grief, and you already have a girlfriend. All right, that's enough.
Huh...？ What, it was just a dream...？
(Having a dream like that... I feel so bad for my girlfriend.)
Hey, don't you feel like... I've changed a little？
Oh, not how I look. You know, on the inside.
On the inside... Now that you mention it, you do seem a bit quieter.
Yeah. I thought I'd try being a little calmer.
Hmm, no real reason. Just thought you might like me better that way.
(A calmer ▲小早川＊▲, huh... That could be nice.)
I've changed a little, haven't I？
Quit staring at me, or I'll kick you.
...You really have. You're kind of scary.
Not scary, just... you know. I figured I'd try being a bit more feisty.
Well, I'd rather not get kicked, though...
That part was a joke. But I figured you might not mind me being like this.
(A feisty ▲小早川＊▲, huh... That could be nice.)
Hey, don't you think my vibe has changed a little？
Come on, notice already. You're making me sad here.
Yeah, exactly. Honest, cheerful Rinko. Not bad, right？
But why all of a sudden？
No big reason. Just figured you might be happier if I acted like this.
(An honest ▲小早川＊▲, huh... That might be nice.)
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. Do you go to Winning Burger much？
Quite a bit. I'm a big-time regular.
Right, you're a high schooler, after all.
What's that supposed to mean？ Though yeah, there are a lot of high schoolers.
I wonder if there's anyone at our school who's never been.
Hmm, who knows. Probably not, right？
Say, ▲小早川＊▲. You know Towano Watcher, right？
What do you think of someone who doesn't get out much using only a magazine to show people around？
Nothing beats experience, right？ Though it might be fine if someone else tags along.
(Yeah, true... I wonder if ▲高嶺＊＊▲ will be okay.)
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. What do you think about going on a practice run to chaperone a date？
I don't really get it, but... isn't that just a date？
What, did someone ask you out on a date？ As if.
(Was that thing with ▲高嶺＊＊▲ a date？ Maybe I shouldn't have turned her down...)
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. What would you do if a senior coworker asked you out to eat？
Depends on how senior they are, I guess... but no need to overthink it, right？
Especially if it's not like you dislike them.
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... There's no way I dislike her, though.)
They asked me at work to come up with ideas for a new menu item.
Ugh, sounds like a pain. Is that even a part-timer's job？
Unless there's some kind of perk to it, I guess.
(A perk... I'd get to go out with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I guess...)
If you promise to go out with someone, you have to keep it, right？
Well, yeah, obviously. You made a promise.
Breaking a promise is just irresponsible as a person.
(Yeah, she's right... What am I gonna do about my promise to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？)
What are you spacing out for... Oh, right, you're always like that.
Hey... seriously, what is it？ You're acting weird.
Thinking how, ▲小早川＊▲, ● really have you as my girlfriend.
...Yeah, you're right. What am ● even saying？
I mean, I don't mind, but...
Not really. I was just thinking back on things.
How ● first met you, everything we went through—
Did you come to some big realization looking back？
Just that ● really couldn't be with anyone but ▲小早川＊▲...
I get what you mean, though.
Thinking back to before we started going out, and all that.
(I'm so glad ▲小早川＊▲ is the one ● get to call my girlfriend...)
